title: vicia lentoides
intro: Vicia lentoides, commonly known as Spring vetchling or vetchling, is a plant species within the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been reported to have various health benefits, including its potential to act as an antidiabetic and anti-inflammatory agent, and it has been traditionally used to treat conditions such as fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Vicia lentoides include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Vicia lentoides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
